title: Classic American Pancakes
description: A simple recipe for fluffy and delicious American-style pancakes.
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt.
In a separate bowl, whisk together eggs, buttermilk, and melted butter.
Pour the wet ingredients into the dry ingredients and stir until just combined.
Heat a non-stick skillet or griddle over medium heat.
Drop the batter by 1/4 cupfuls onto the skillet or griddle.
Cook for 2-3 minutes, until bubbles appear on the surface and the edges start to dry.
Flip and cook for another 1-2 minutes, until golden brown.
